---
Test
---
|import|
|io.github.tortaje.hvault|
|io.github.tortaje.rest|

|script|HVault|
|read secret|fitnesse/oauth|key|client_id|into|clientId|
|read secret|fitnesse/oauth|key|client_secret|into|clientSecret|

|script|Rest|
|client credentials;|secret:clientId|secret:clientSecret|
|header;|Content-Type|application/json|
|header;|Accept|application/json|
|body|{"customer": {"name": "ACME", "country": "FR"}, "lines": [{"sku": "A1", "qty": 2}, {"sku": "B7", "qty": 1}]}|
|post|/orders|
|check|status|201|
|check|response header|Content-Type|application/json|
|$orderId=|json|$.id|
|check|json|$.status|CREATED|

|script|
|get|/orders/$orderId|
|check|status|200|
|check|json|$.customer.name|ACME|
|check|json|$.lines[1].sku|B7|
|check|json|$.lines.length()|2|
|check|json|$.lines[?(@.sku == "A1")].qty|[2]|
|check|json|$.total.amount|129.5|
|ensure|response contains|EUR|

|script|
|body|{"status": "UPDATED"}|
|put|/orders/$orderId|
|check|status|200|
|check|json|$.status|UPDATED|
|delete|/orders/$orderId|
|check|status|204|
